conventions.units: metres, Y up; positions are floats on a 1/4096 m grid
conventions.characters: bind pose faces +Z; a part has no skin of its own: skinIndex/skinWeight refer to characters.skeleton.joints in order
conventions.cars: front is +Z, left is +X, ground is y = 0, origin between the axles
conventions.rims: wheel of radius 1 around the X axis, face towards +X, centred on the tyre
conventions.business: a diorama on a round base: the floor is y = 0, the front is +Z; materials are named by what they are (matte, metal, glass, glow, print, print_glow, shadow)
conventions.casino: symbols.file is one row of square pictures, `cell` pixels each, in the order of `order` (the symbol keys of the backend); no model: the client builds the machine. cards.file is a sheet of playing cards, `cell` pixels each ([width, height]): a column per rank in the order of `ranks`, a row per suit in the order of `suits` (a card of the backend is its rank and its suit, `AS`), and one more column of `backs` card backs, one under the other and then again
conventions.paths: relative to this manifest; {key}, {id} and {size} in `paths` are filled from the records below

wear.uv: TEXCOORD_0 of every Car and rim mesh except plates: a box projection, 1 UV unit = 1 m (rims: 1 wheel radius)
